suggested_experiment_name: PPTA DR2 (Parkes Pulsar Timing Array Data Release 2)
coupling_convention: dimensionless kinetic mixing χ (epsilon squared, ε²), plotted on y-axis as e² (dimensionless)
notes: | selector: figure_vision (sole candidate) | Vision: Extracted lower boundary of the PPTA DR2 correlated exclusion region (red solid line, left panel of FIG. 1) for U(1)_B dark photon. The plot shows constraints on dark photon mass (x-axis, log scale in eV) versus coupling constant e² (y-axis, log scale, dimensionless). The excluded region (yellow shaded) lies ABOVE the boundary. The boundary exhibits a characteristic V-shaped minimum around 8–10 × 10^-23 eV, with steeper slopes on both sides. Sampling density increased near the minimum (kink region) and decreased on the smooth outer portions. The WEP experiments constraint is shown as a horizontal line at ~10^-46. The paper constrains ultralight fuzzy dark matter (DPDM) using pulsar timing residuals from 26 pulsars in the PPTA DR2 dataset. | Calibration: No calibration needed | WARNING: median coupling 2.5e-52 outside range [1e-22, 1e+00]; no decade factor recovers it | contract: median outside VALID_RANGES after corrections (flagged low confidence)
